title: (רב) ענן בר חייא

paragraphs: (Rav) Anan bar Ḥiyya, Yevamot 116a, in the final chapter: a divorce deed found at Sura read, 'I, Anan bar Ḥiyya of Nehardea, release and divorce,' etc. He testified with Rav Ḥanan bar Rava before Mar Shemuel. [Geniva is named in a separate tradition about Ḥanan.].
